description_en: Queries the statistics of asset exposure analysis
description_zh: 查询资产暴露分析的统计信息
name: DescribeExposedStatistics

ExposedAsapVulCount.description_en: The total number of high-risk vulnerabilities that are exposed on the Internet and can be exploited by hackers
ExposedAsapVulCount.description_zh: 暴露在互联网上可被黑客利用的高危漏洞总数量

ExposedComponentCount.description_en: The total number of system components (such as OpenSSL and OpenSSH) on your servers that are exposed on the Internet
ExposedComponentCount.description_zh: 暴露在互联网上的您服务器的系统组件（例如OpenSSL、OpenSSH）总数量

ExposedDdsCount.description_en: The number of ApsaraDB for MongoDB database assets exposed on the Internet
ExposedDdsCount.description_zh: 暴露在互联网上的MONGODB数据库资产数量

ExposedEcsCount.description_en: The number of ECS assets exposed on the Internet
ExposedEcsCount.description_zh: 暴露在互联网上的ECS资产数量

ExposedInstanceCount.description_en: The total number of assets exposed on the Internet
ExposedInstanceCount.description_zh: 暴露在互联网上的资产总数量

ExposedIpCount.description_en: The total number of IP addresses exposed on the Internet
ExposedIpCount.description_zh: 暴露在互联网上的IP地址总数量

ExposedKvstoreCount.description_en: The number of ApsaraDB for Redis database assets exposed on the Internet
ExposedKvstoreCount.description_zh: 暴露在互联网上的RDS-Redis版数据库资产数量

ExposedLaterVulCount.description_en: The total number of medium-risk vulnerabilities that are exposed on the Internet and can be exploited by hackers
ExposedLaterVulCount.description_zh: 暴露在互联网上可被黑客利用的中危漏洞总数量

ExposedNntfVulCount.description_en: The total number of low-risk vulnerabilities that are exposed on the Internet and can be exploited by hackers
ExposedNntfVulCount.description_zh: 暴露在互联网上可被黑客利用的低危漏洞总数量

ExposedPortCount.description_en: The total number of ports exposed on the Internet
ExposedPortCount.description_zh: 暴露在互联网上的端口总数量

ExposedRdsCount.description_en: The number of RDS database assets exposed on the Internet
ExposedRdsCount.description_zh: 暴露在互联网上的RDS数据库资产数量

ExposedWeekPasswordMachineCount.description_en: The total number of system keys on your servers that are exposed on the Internet
ExposedWeekPasswordMachineCount.description_zh: 暴露在互联网上的您服务器的系统密钥的总数量

GatewayAssetCount.description_en: The total number of gateway assets (Server Load Balancer and NAT Gateway) exposed on the Internet
GatewayAssetCount.description_zh: 暴露在互联网上的网关资产（负载均衡、NAT网关）总数量

RequestId.description_en: The ID of this request, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. It can be used to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
